crosschecks.headline: Residency language weakened, still no EEA workforce
crosschecks.detail: 66 of 74 placeable roles name no EEA site — most prominently United States, India. The privacy policy no longer commits to EU-only storage.

claim.text: Customer data may be stored and processed in any country where Meridian Cloud or its sub-processors maintain data centers, including the United States and India.

crosschecks.question: Which countries can now receive customer data under this clause, and did any customer agree to the change?

crosschecks.headline: Sub-processor notice period dropped from the DPA
crosschecks.detail: The DPA previously committed to 30 days’ notice and a right to object before a new sub-processor was added. The current text points customers to a list that can change with no notice window at all.

claim.text: Meridian Cloud will notify the customer of new sub-processors via the online sub-processor list, which may be updated at any time.

evidence.excerpt: Previous DPA (2026-07-19): "Customer will be notified of any new sub-processor at least 30 days in advance and may object."

crosschecks.question: Why was the 30-day notice-and-objection window removed, and does any signed customer contract still reference it?

hunks.before: Customer data collected from users in the European Union is stored exclusively on servers located within the European Union.
hunks.after: Customer data may be stored and processed in any country where Meridian Cloud or its sub-processors maintain data centers, including the United States and India.

hunks.before: Customer will be notified of any new sub-processor at least 30 days in advance and may object.
hunks.after: Meridian Cloud will notify the customer of new sub-processors via the online sub-processor list, which may be updated at any time.
